title: holospot settings
description: What the `settings` option of the kit accepts (Holo, holo.apply, holo.card, holo.setScene, obj.set): a flat map of parameter ids to values, or a Copy settings blob from holo.spot. Generated by tools/gen-schema.mjs from src/data/params.json; do not edit.

settings.title: Flat settings map
settings.description: Parameter ids to values. Scene ids apply to the whole Holo. Material ids apply to the object's own material; ids of the other materials are ignored.

copySettings.title: Copy settings blob
copySettings.description: What the Copy settings button of holo.spot puts on the clipboard, and the shape of the files in presets/. It names its own look (entity) and material.

entity.description: The kind of object on holo.spot the look was made on.

assets.description: SVG artwork by name, for values that read "asset:<name>".

view.title: View
view.description: How holo.spot frames the look: the camera's orbit around the object in degrees (az, el), the zoom (a factor on the fitted distance) and an offset of the object in millimetres. shotCamera() applies it.

pose.title: Pose
pose.description: The tilt holo.spot rests the object at, in degrees about x, y and z; flip shows the back. shotRotation() turns it into a rotation.

scene.title: Scene settings
scene.description: Settings shared by every holographic object: lights (studio.*), display.*, grain.*, bump.*, dof.*, card.*, scene.background, scene.bgColor, scene.print. The list is holo.spot's whole scene panel; properties marked x-kit-ignores are accepted and change nothing in the kit.

scene.material.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Active holographic material (panel swap, program, spectral tables, print text).

scene.object.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Object carrying the foil: the card, a bent card, a rippled sheet, crumpled foil, a can label, a sphere, a torus, the Holo cloth, the sticker wall, a flag on a pole in the wind or your own GLB / glTF model.

scene.orbit.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Inert since UI v2: the orbit view is always on unless the view is frozen (drag empty space to orbit, Space or right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom). Kept so saved versions, views, links (orbit=0/1) and stored settings that carry it load unchanged.

scene.orbitGlide.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). The orbit view: smoothing while dragging and momentum after release (a flick keeps spinning and coasts to a stop); 0 = direct.

scene.autoMotion.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Automatic motion: idle wobble, the first-load pose, idle micro-motion, the spring back to rest after a drag and, on the sticker wall, the hover tilt. Off = the object only moves when you drag it and stays exactly where you leave it.

dof.on.description: Depth of field: a thin-lens camera blur on the HDR image (bokeh from glints, near/far layering); off = no pass at all.

dof.fstop.description: Aperture f-number N (the lens's third-stop series): entrance pupil A = f/N, CoC ∝ A.

dof.focus.description: Focus: the object's centre (follows pose, orbit and zoom), a picked point on the object, or a manual distance.

dof.point.description: Picked focus point in object coordinates: x, y in object half-extents (the card: 31.5 × 44 mm); set by a pick.

dof.pointZ.description: Picked focus point: depth in object bounding radii (front face of the card ≈ 0).

dof.distance.description: Focus distance from the camera (manual focus only). Unit: cm.

dof.offset.description: Shifts the focus plane along the view axis (object and point focus): + behind, − in front. Unit: mm.

dof.lens.description: Focal length on a 36 × 24 mm sensor: sets the fov (62 mm = the 22° camera) and steps back to keep the framing. Unit: mm.

dof.blades.description: Aperture blades (0 = a perfectly circular stop): the polygon of the bokeh.

dof.bladeAngle.description: Rotation of the aperture polygon. Unit: °.

dof.catsEye.description: Optical vignetting: toward the frame edges the barrel clips the aperture into a tangential lemon.

dof.rim.description: Spherical aberration: + bright rims on background bokeh and soft foreground bokeh (under-corrected), − the reverse.

dof.loca.description: Longitudinal chromatic aberration: magenta rims on foreground bokeh, green on background bokeh (in focus stays neutral).

scene.background.description: Page colour and the lighting adaptation (exposure, fill, camera side, backdrop, panel theme); Colour: the colour below, the adaptation scaled by its lightness.

scene.bgColor.description: The page colour of background Colour (picking one switches the background to Colour). A colour as #rrggbb.

scene.print.description: Print layout over the foil: full-art card, art window, bare-foil frame, or no print (card and bent card only).

scene.wall.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: the stickers placed on it, bottom to top ("" = an empty wall).

scene.wallArt1.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: uploaded design u1, its cleaned SVG (a data URL; "" = an empty slot; links write "upload").

scene.wallArt2.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: uploaded design u2, its cleaned SVG (a data URL; "" = an empty slot; links write "upload").

scene.wallArt3.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: uploaded design u3, its cleaned SVG (a data URL; "" = an empty slot; links write "upload").

scene.wallArt4.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: uploaded design u4, its cleaned SVG (a data URL; "" = an empty slot; links write "upload").

scene.wallFill1.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: the holo fill of uploaded design u1 — the wall's material, one of the five foils, or its own colours printed on white vinyl.

scene.wallFill2.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: the holo fill of uploaded design u2 — the wall's material, one of the five foils, or its own colours printed on white vinyl.

scene.wallFill3.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: the holo fill of uploaded design u3 — the wall's material, one of the five foils, or its own colours printed on white vinyl.

scene.wallFill4.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: the holo fill of uploaded design u4 — the wall's material, one of the five foils, or its own colours printed on white vinyl.

scene.flagImage.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: the picture printed on the fabric (a data URL ≤ 1280 px; "" = none; links write "upload").

object.bend.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Bent card: total arc angle of the curl around the long axis (front convex). Unit: °.

object.amplitude.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Rippled sheet: ripple amplitude (plus a cross-ripple of 0.22× at 1.9× the wavelength). Unit: mm.

object.wavelength.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Rippled sheet: ripple wavelength. Unit: mm.

object.crumple.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Crumpled foil: crumple strength (facet tilt, crease depth).

object.seed.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Crumpled foil: crease pattern.

object.modelSize.description: Your model: largest bounding-box side (centred, uniformly scaled; shards, flakes and bump tiles keep their mm size). Unit: mm.

object.modelMapping.description: Your model: surface coordinates for the foil patterns: its UVs (auto: when usable), a box or a spherical projection.

object.structureScale.description: Your model: × the mm-per-UV estimate (above 1 smaller shards, flakes and bump; below 1 larger).

object.doubleSided.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Your model: foil on both faces (a reversed copy of every triangle; set automatically for open meshes on load).

object.clothSize.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Holo cloth (holo foil): the long side (the image cloth follows its picture at 88 mm, like the image card). Unit: mm.

object.clothAspect.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Holo cloth (holo foil): width / height (a new aspect starts from the drape again).

object.clothViscosity.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Holo cloth: how fast motion dies out in the gel, per 60 Hz frame.

object.clothStiffness.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Holo cloth: strength of the stretch, shear and bend constraints (lower: a stretchier, softer cloth).

object.clothSmoothing.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Holo cloth: Laplacian smoothing per step: wrinkles relax back out.

object.clothMemory.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Holo cloth: pull back toward the starting drape (0: the cloth keeps whatever shape it is left in).

object.clothFloat.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Holo cloth: gentle random nudges now and then, so the cloth keeps floating.

object.clothGrab.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Holo cloth: the patch a grab pulls, as a share of the cloth's long side. Unit: %.

object.clothShadow.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Holo cloth: darkening inside the folds.

object.clothTwoSided.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Holo cloth (holo foil): the foil on both faces (off: the card's back on the reverse; the image cloth always has a plain back).

object.wallView.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: millimetres of wall across the canvas width (the camera steps back for more; stickers keep their real size). Unit: mm.

object.wallParallax.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: how much the view follows the pointer — a slight orbit and tilt that makes the foil play (0 = perfectly still).

object.wallBorder.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: a ring of white vinyl around every sticker's outline (off: the built-ins as cut, an upload only the border that holds it together).

object.wallBorderMm.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: the white border's width in the design's millimetres (a sticker at scale 2 shows twice that). Unit: mm.

object.wallShadow.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: darkness of the shadows the stickers cast on the wall and on each other.

object.wallShadowSoft.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: how far the shadows spread (0 crisp … 1 a wide soft halo); they stay tight where a sticker lies flat.

object.wallContact.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: the thin dark line right along each sticker's edge.

object.wallBumps.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: overall unevenness of a hand-applied sticker — waviness, dents, the laminate's orange peel (0 = flat).

object.wallBubbles.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: air trapped under the vinyl, more where the apply closed on itself.

object.wallCreases.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: fine creases and the laminate's wrinkle network where slack was pressed in.

object.wallEdgeLift.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: corners and edge stretches that did not stick, raised up to 1.5 mm.

object.wallGloss.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: gloss of the clear laminate over the print (0 satin … 1 glossy).

object.wallStiffness.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: bending stiffness of the vinyl while it is held, applied or peeled (lower: a floppier sheet).

object.wallAdhesion.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Sticker wall: strength of the adhesive (higher: a sticker peels off harder).

object.flagPaused.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: freezes the flag where it is — no simulation, no redraw, no pulling (a drag tilts instead).

object.flagTimeSpeed.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: how fast its world runs — 1 real time, 0.25 four times slower (slow motion), 2 twice as fast: the same motion, slowed or sped up (a frozen view's moment does not depend on it). Unit: ×.

object.flagWind.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: free-stream wind speed at the pole, acting on a flag 1 m high whatever its drawn size. Unit: m/s.

object.flagWindDir.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: the wind about the pole — 0 the flag flies to the right, face-on; +90 toward you; −90 away; ±180 to the left. Unit: °.

object.flagWindLift.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: the wind's tilt from the pole's perpendicular (+ toward the finial). Unit: °.

object.flagGust.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: gust strength and frequency — at 1 lulls to −30 % and bursts to +80 % of the speed; the direction swings ±9°.

object.flagTurb.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: strength of the eddies that make the flag ripple and flap.

object.flagFlutter.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: length of the travelling eddies, so of the folds, in flag heights (shorter = more, quicker folds). Unit: ×.

object.flagSeed.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: another sequence of gusts and eddies (a frozen view shows another moment).

object.flagSurface.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: what it is made of — printed fabric (your picture, else a plain colour) or the holo foil of the mode's material.

object.flagColour.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: the plain fabric's colour (printed fabric without a picture). A colour as #rrggbb.

object.flagSize.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: the hoist as drawn (sets the foil's pattern scale and the depth of field, not the physics). Unit: mm.

object.flagAspect.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: its length over its height (a picture sets them while it is on the fabric).

object.flagTail.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: the shape of its free end (the picture is cut by it, never squeezed).

object.flagTailDepth.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: × the tail's own depth (not for a straight flag). Unit: ×.

object.flagWeight.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: areal mass (knitted polyester flag 110; silk 50; heavy cotton 250) — heavier flies lower and flaps slower. Unit: g/m².

object.flagStiffness.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: bending stiffness — low = fine ripples, high = broad folds.

object.flagSheen.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag (printed fabric): 0 matte cotton … 1 satin.

object.flagTranslucency.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag (printed fabric): light through the cloth — a backlit flag glows, the picture shows through mirrored.

object.flagShadow.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: darkening inside the folds (the Holo cloth's cavity term).

object.flagPoleAngle.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: lean of the pole, + = top to the left; the flag and the wind turn with it, gravity does not. Unit: °.

object.flagAttach.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: rings hold the hoist at a few points and it billows between them; a sleeve holds it along its whole length.

object.flagRings.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: how many rings hold the hoist (rings only).

object.flagFinial.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Flag: the ornament on top of the pole.

studio.preset.description: Lighting preset; selecting one writes its light and ambient values.

studio.panel.dir.description: Direction of the panel centre as pad direction cosines in the rest frame.

studio.panel.width.description: Radial angular size of the panel (along ê_θ). Unit: °.

studio.panel.length.description: Tangential angular size of the panel (along ê_φ). Unit: °.

studio.panel.distance.description: Distance of the panel centre from the card centre. Unit: m.

studio.panel.spd.description: Emission spectrum of the panel (SPD table layer).

studio.spotA.dir.description: Direction of spot A (slot 1) as pad direction cosines (x, y) = sinθ(cosφ, sinφ) in the rest frame.

studio.spotA.size.description: Angular diameter of spot A (slot 1) seen from the card centre. Unit: °.

studio.spotA.distance.description: Distance of spot A (slot 1) from the card centre. Unit: m.

studio.spotA.spd.description: Emission spectrum of spot A (slot 1) (SPD table layer).

studio.spotB.dir.description: Direction of spot B (slot 2) as pad direction cosines (x, y) = sinθ(cosφ, sinφ) in the rest frame.

studio.spotB.size.description: Angular diameter of spot B (slot 2) seen from the card centre. Unit: °.

studio.spotB.distance.description: Distance of spot B (slot 2) from the card centre. Unit: m.

studio.spotB.spd.description: Emission spectrum of spot B (slot 2) (SPD table layer).

studio.spotC.dir.description: Direction of spot C (slot 3) as pad direction cosines (x, y) = sinθ(cosφ, sinφ) in the rest frame.

studio.spotC.size.description: Angular diameter of spot C (slot 3) seen from the card centre. Unit: °.

studio.spotC.distance.description: Distance of spot C (slot 3) from the card centre. Unit: m.

studio.spotC.spd.description: Emission spectrum of spot C (slot 3) (SPD table layer).

studio.ambient.rims.description: Radiance of the two grazing rim strips (environment).

studio.ambient.scrim.description: Radiance of the graded scrim above the lens (environment; makes unlit metal read as metal).

studio.ambient.cameraSide.description: Radiance of the camera-side hemisphere not covered by panels (dark field).

studio.ambient.cameraTexture.description: Blend from a uniform to a blob-textured camera side (factor 0.5–5, mean 1).

studio.ambient.backdrop.description: Behind-card hemisphere on the white page (× 0.6).

studio.ambient.rotation.description: Rotation of the environment about the card normal at rest. Unit: °.

studio.flash.size.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Diameter of the flashlight (slot 3 in pointer modes light and flash). Unit: mm.

studio.flash.distance.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Distance of the flashlight in pointer mode light. Unit: m.

studio.flash.radiance.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Radiance of the flashlight.

studio.flash.spd.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Emission spectrum of the flashlight.

display.ev.description: Exposure in stops (EV); the white page subtracts 0.2. Unit: stops.

display.tone.description: Tone curve: Khronos PBR Neutral (hue-stable), AgX, or clamp.

display.glareRadius.description: Glare falloff radius in CSS px (level weights). Unit: px.

display.quality.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Quality tier; explicit values disable runtime adaptation.

display.wideGamut.description: Display P3 output where the display and browser support it.

grain.on.description: Film grain over the image; off = no grain at all.

grain.amount.description: Grain amplitude in display code values, (u − ½)·amount with u uniform in [0, 1).

grain.size.description: Grain cell size in CSS px (≥ 1 device px; cells larger than a device pixel are smooth value noise). Unit: px.

grain.animated.description: Re-seed the grain every frame or keep one static pattern; frozen views (freeze=1) seed from t.

grain.colour.description: Monochrome grain or independent noise per colour channel.

grain.onBackground.description: Grain over the page too; off multiplies it by the object's coverage so the page stays exactly #000 / #FFF.

card.bow.description: Card bow (sag over the bow axis). Unit: mm.

card.bowAxis.description: Bow axis: across the width or along the length.

card.corner.description: Corner radius of the card outline. Unit: mm.

card.emboss.description: Embossed texture: none, lines, or cross-hatch.

card.embossPitch.description: Period of the embossed texture. Unit: mm.

card.embossHeight.description: Peak-to-valley height of the embossed texture. Unit: µm.

card.embossLayer.description: Layer carrying the emboss: the foil (board waves) or a textured varnish (coat waves).

card.border.description: Border: opaque white ink or bare foil.

card.borderColor.description: Border ink colour (as printed on white). A colour as #rrggbb.

card.backColor.description: Diffuse colour of the card back. A colour as #rrggbb.

card.edgeSilver.description: Silvered card edge (foil wrapped to the outline).

card.wear.description: Imperfections: smudges, scratches, dust, mottling, corner whitening.

bump.map.description: Height image (luminance = height): a built-in map, an uploaded image or none (URL: scratches, brushed, …, a same-origin path, none). One of the built-in values (see examples), a URL or a data URL.

bump.strength.description: Relief height = strength × H₀; slopes scale linearly, 0 switches the map off.

bump.tiling.description: Repeats of the map across the object's U span; the slopes do not change.

bump.layer.description: Embossed foil (the stack bends: diffraction and mirror deflect) or a textured varnish (coat only).

motion.pointer.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Pointer mode: tilt the card, move the flashlight, or a coaxial flash at the camera.

motion.tiltRange.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Hover / touch tilt at the canvas edge. Unit: °.

motion.spring.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Pose spring (physics, time or easing mode).

motion.pose.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Base pose: x = yaw ry, y = pitch rx (URL key tilt = rx,ry). Unit: °.

motion.hold.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Hold the pose: no return to rest, drag snap-back or auto wobble.

motion.wobble.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Hand-like auto wobble while idle.

motion.wobbleAmp.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Auto-wobble amplitude. Unit: °.

motion.gyro.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). Device orientation tilts the card and world-locks the lights.

motion.gyroGain.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). On-screen card tilt per device tilt.

prism.pitch.description: Grating period d (1000 nm = 1000 l/mm). Unit: nm.

prism.grooveAngle.description: Groove direction in the card plane, CCW from card +x; bands run parallel to it. Unit: °.

prism.pattern.description: Groove layout: straight lines; circles around the card centre; rays from the card centre.

prism.depth.description: Sinusoid peak-to-valley depth h (buried). Unit: nm.

prism.coverage.description: Area fraction carrying the grating; the rest is flat mirror.

prism.fan.description: RMS spread of first-order light along the grooves. Unit: °.

prism.nc.description: Index of the lacquer/laminate touching the relief.

prism.roughness.description: RMS micro-slope of the metallised relief, per axis. Unit: °.

prism.tint.description: Lacquer dye filter: clear / long-pass (gold) / short-pass (blue).

prism.tintWidth.description: Half-width of the filter edge. Unit: nm.

prism.tintFloor.description: Double-pass transmittance on the blocked side.

prism.waviness.description: RMS slope of 8–40 mm board waviness. Unit: °.

prism.orangePeel.description: RMS height of 0.5–5 mm coat undulation. Unit: µm.

shatter.size.description: Mean shard pitch after chord splitting (the Voronoi level uses 2× this). Unit: mm.

shatter.chords.description: Mean number of straight chords splitting each Voronoi cell (T-junctions).

shatter.orientK.description: Number of discrete groove orientations; 0 = continuous (12 = the 15° steps of stepped originations).

shatter.tilt.description: RMS physical micro-tilt of the buried shard per axis. Unit: °.

shatter.pitchA.description: Period of shard family A. Unit: nm.

shatter.pitchB.description: Period of family B. Unit: nm.

shatter.pitchC.description: Period of family C. Unit: nm.

shatter.coverage.description: Mean grating coverage of a shard (each shard draws w in ±0.1 around it); the rest is flat dyed mirror.

shatter.chirp.description: ± pitch gradient across a shard (UNVERIFIED in real foils). Unit: %.

shatter.ridgeH.description: Maximum relief-crease height (negative = groove); each creased border draws its height in [0, H]. Unit: µm.

shatter.creaseShare.description: Share of borders that carry a crease. Unit: %.

shatter.nc.description: Index of the lacquer/laminate touching the relief.

shatter.roughness.description: RMS micro-slope of the metallised relief, per axis. Unit: °.

shatter.tint.description: Lacquer dye filter: clear / long-pass (gold) / short-pass (blue).

shatter.tintWidth.description: Half-width of the filter edge. Unit: nm.

shatter.tintFloor.description: Double-pass transmittance on the blocked side.

shatter.waviness.description: RMS slope of 8–40 mm board waviness. Unit: °.

shatter.orangePeel.description: RMS height of 0.5–5 mm coat undulation. Unit: µm.

nebula.size.description: Flat-to-flat flake size D. Unit: µm.

nebula.layers.description: Stacked flake layers (55 / 81 / 91 % cover for hex).

nebula.tilt.description: RMS physical flake slope per axis (buried). Unit: °.

nebula.curv.description: RMS slope variation within a flake. Unit: °.

nebula.coverage.description: Area fraction of a flake carrying the grating; the rest is flat dyed mirror.

nebula.pitchMax.description: Largest flake period (swap if min > max). Unit: nm.

nebula.starSize.description: Mean star-dot diameter (each star ×0.6–1.4). Unit: µm.

nebula.starDensity.description: Share of 1.25·D_star lattice cells that hold a star. Unit: %.

nebula.baseColor.description: Ink under the binder. Unit: colour. A colour as #rrggbb.

nebula.tint.description: Binder dye filter: clear / long-pass (gold) / short-pass (blue).

nebula.tintWidth.description: Half-width of the filter edge. Unit: nm.

nebula.tintFloor.description: Double-pass transmittance on the blocked side.

nebula.waviness.description: RMS slope of 8–40 mm board waviness. Unit: °.

nebula.orangePeel.description: RMS height of 0.5–5 mm coat undulation. Unit: µm.

sparkle.size.description: Mean dot diameter D. Unit: µm.

sparkle.coverage.description: Union area cover C of the two dot layers.

sparkle.irregularity.description: Outline lobes a₂, a₃ ≤ 0.15·v and size spread ±0.4·v.

sparkle.tilt.description: RMS buried dot tilt per axis. Unit: °.

sparkle.dome.description: RMS slope variation within a dot. Unit: °.

sparkle.orientJitter.description: RMS per-dot groove-orientation error (aligned dots). Unit: °.

sparkle.pitch.description: Dot and haze grating period. Unit: nm.

sparkle.grooveAngle.description: Groove direction, CCW from card +x (bands run along it). Unit: °.

sparkle.fan.description: Diffuser spread of aligned dots along the grooves. Unit: °.

sparkle.pitchJitter.description: RMS per-dot relative pitch error. Unit: %.

sparkle.speckShare.description: Share of dots that are specks. Unit: %.

sparkle.speckType.description: dyed: non-diffracting blue-dyed satin dots; grating: randomly oriented fine-pitch gratings.

sparkle.speckDyePeak.description: Peak λ_s of the speck dye (dyed type). Unit: nm.

sparkle.speckDyeWidth.description: Gaussian half-width w_s of the speck dye. Unit: nm.

sparkle.speckDyeFloor.description: Double-pass T² of the speck dye away from the peak.

sparkle.speckPitch.description: Speck grating period (grating type). Unit: nm.

sparkle.matte.description: Total RMS micro-slope of the matte base (buried): sand-cell tilt and intra-cell slope together. Unit: °.

sparkle.sandTilt.description: RMS buried tilt per sand cell and axis (clamped to ≤ the matte roughness). Unit: °.

sparkle.hazeShare.description: Share of the base carrying the shallow grating.

sparkle.hazeRoughness.description: RMS micro-slope of the haze patches. Unit: °.

sparkle.hazeFan.description: Diffuser spread of the haze grating. Unit: °.

sparkle.tintFloor.description: Double-pass T² on the blocked side.

sparkle.waviness.description: RMS slope of 8–40 mm board waviness. Unit: °.

sparkle.orangePeel.description: RMS height of 0.5–5 mm coat undulation. Unit: µm.

vortex.pitch.description: Radial pitch d₀ (= the local pitch at r ≫ r_s). Unit: nm.

vortex.swirl.description: r_s: where the grooves run at 45°; 0 = concentric (CD-like). Unit: mm.

vortex.centre.description: Centre offset in half-domain units (x, y).

vortex.bands.description: Number of spiral coverage bands (0 = none).

vortex.contrast.description: 1 − w_lo: coverage contrast of the bands.

vortex.nc.description: Index of the lacquer touching the relief.

vortex.roughness.description: RMS micro-slope of the metallised relief, per axis. Unit: °.

vortex.tint.description: Lacquer dye filter: clear / long-pass (gold) / short-pass (blue).

vortex.tintWidth.description: Half-width of the filter edge. Unit: nm.

vortex.tintFloor.description: Double-pass transmittance on the blocked side.

vortex.waviness.description: RMS slope of 8–40 mm board waviness. Unit: °.

vortex.orangePeel.description: RMS height of 0.5–5 mm coat undulation. Unit: µm.

vortex.seed.description: Random seed (wave phases; the spiral itself is deterministic).

volume.type.description: Reflection (Denisyuk volume hologram: full parallax, Bragg colour) or rainbow (embossed Benton: horizontal parallax, vertical colour sweep).

volume.subject.description: Recorded object (signed-distance volume assets/holo3d/<subject>.sdf). Or the URL of a volume baked with tools/bake-hologram.mjs (http(s):, data:, blob:, or a path starting with /, ./ or ../).

volume.size.description: Size of the recorded object (its longest dimension). Unit: mm.

volume.depth.description: Depth of the object centre (negative = behind the surface; parts may come forward). Unit: mm.

volume.yaw.description: Recorded pose: turn about the vertical axis. Unit: °.

volume.pitch.description: Recorded pose: tip about the horizontal axis (positive: top toward the viewer). Unit: °.

volume.recLight.description: Direction of the recording light (baked shading), direction cosines in the sticker frame.

volume.speckle.description: Contrast of the recorded laser speckle.

volume.backdrop.description: Background layer: a deep plane recorded behind the object (grid, stars) or a diffractive surface-relief pattern around it (seal … sparkle: each line family is a grating with its own direction, so it flashes its own rainbow colour as the card tilts).

volume.backdropDepth.description: Depth of the recorded background layer (grid, stars). Unit: mm.

volume.patternSize.description: Diffractive pattern: radius of the seal / scale of the pattern, centred on the hologram. Unit: mm.

volume.lineWidth.description: Diffractive pattern: line width as a fraction of the line spacing (lines finer than ≈ 2 px fade to their mean coverage).

volume.gratingPitch.description: Diffractive pattern: period of the relief grating inside the lines (λ = Λ·|(ℓ̂ + v̂)ₜ·ĝ| in the first order: finer → the colours need steeper light). Unit: nm.

volume.patternStrength.description: Diffractive pattern: brightness (grating coverage × efficiency gain; 1 = metallised lines at full first-order efficiency).

volume.patternRotation.description: Diffractive pattern: rotation about the hologram centre. Unit: °.

volume.patternDepth.description: Diffractive pattern: depth of its plane behind the surface (0 = on the film; shallow, as on real 2D/3D labels). Unit: mm.

volume.colour.description: Replay wavelength at the reference geometry (reflection: Bragg colour, shrinkage included; rainbow: the straight-on colour). Unit: nm.

volume.bandwidth.description: Reflection: Bragg bandwidth (FWHM; thicker emulsion → narrower). Unit: nm.

volume.reference.description: Reference (replay) beam direction cosines in the sticker frame: where the light must be for the undistorted image.

volume.selectivity.description: Reflection: half-width σ of the replay window on the replayed direction (the image fades as the light leaves the reference or the eye the viewing zone). Unit: °.

volume.slit.description: Rainbow: vertical slit width (colour purity vs vertical viewing zone). Unit: °.

volume.recording.description: Optical recording of the object (continuous parallax) or a holographic stereogram made from N camera views (the 3D image steps from view to view as you move, with a brief double image at the boundaries; diffractive patterns stay continuous).

volume.views.description: Stereogram: number of recorded views across the viewing zone (per axis; rainbow: horizontal only).

volume.viewBlend.description: Stereogram: width of the cross-fade at a view boundary as a fraction of the view spacing (0 = hard cuts; higher = a longer ghosted double image).

volume.viewZone.description: Stereogram: half-angle of the zone the views span (beyond it the edge view stays). Unit: °.

volume.waviness.description: RMS slope of 8–40 mm film waviness. Unit: °.

volume.coatAlpha.description: Roughness of the glossy top film. Unit: GGX α.

volume.glare.description: How strongly the surface mirrors the lights: 1 = the physical mirror (rainbow: bare aluminium; both: the cover film's full highlight), lower = the embossed film's zero order is weaker and hazier, the cover film's glint smaller, and the highlight is soft-limited so the image and the pattern stay visible under it.

volume.orangePeel.description: RMS height of 0.5–5 mm top-film undulation. Unit: µm.

emboss.element.description: The placed element: the hot-stamped foil logo, or a volume-hologram sticker (a 3D image at depth in a die-cut patch) on the same emboss; switching to the sticker in the panel sets a 30 mm square, 250 µm raised (once).

emboss.logo.description: Logo artwork: a built-in SVG mark or an uploaded SVG / PNG (transparent = no logo); URL: rosette, koru, …, a same-origin path, none. One of the built-in values (see examples), a URL or a data URL.

emboss.shape.description: Hologram sticker: die-cut shape — square (rounded corners), sharp rectangle, rounded rectangle, circle, oval, or the outline of the logo artwork.

emboss.aspect.description: Hologram sticker: width / height of the rectangle, rounded rectangle and oval (square and circle: 1; logo outline: the artwork's).

emboss.cornerRadius.description: Hologram sticker: corner radius of the square and the rounded rectangle. Unit: mm.

emboss.x.description: Logo centre, card x (from the left edge of the 63 mm card; a wider image card extends it to −12.5 … 75.5; other objects: offset from the face centre by x − 31.5). Unit: mm.

emboss.y.description: Logo centre, card y (from the bottom edge; other objects: offset y − 44). Unit: mm.

emboss.width.description: Width of the logo's artwork; its height follows the artwork's aspect ratio. Unit: mm.

emboss.edit.description: Not used by the kit (a holo.spot setting, accepted and ignored). On-card logo editor (key E): the card faces the camera; click the logo, drag to move, drag a corner to scale.

emboss.height.description: Emboss height of the logo above the paper (debossed: depth). Unit: µm.

emboss.shoulder.description: Wall width: horizontal run of the sculpted shoulder from the paper to the top. Unit: mm.

emboss.profile.description: Die profile: rounded shoulders, a bevel, a sculpted (pillowed) dome, or pressed into the paper.

emboss.puff.description: Stretched-paper swell outside the wall (height up to 12 % of the emboss, reach 0.6–1.8 mm).

emboss.foil.description: Hot-stamping foil: linear rainbow grating, concentric rings, sparkle cells, plain silver or gold.

emboss.pitch.description: Grating period of the foil. Unit: nm.

emboss.grooveAngle.description: Groove direction (rainbow foil), CCW from card +x; the grating rides on the embossed surface. Unit: °.

emboss.foilCoverage.description: How far the foil runs down the walls (1 = to the foot of the wall, 0 = top of the shoulder only).

emboss.edgeBreakup.description: Microscopically ragged foil edge and tiny voids in the paper's tooth valleys.

emboss.showThrough.description: How much of the paper's tooth telegraphs through the foil or the hologram sticker's film (relief and haze).

emboss.gloss.description: Foil top-coat gloss (1 = mirror-smooth lacquer, 0 = satin).

emboss.sparkleSize.description: Cell size of the sparkle foil (each cell its own grating orientation). Unit: µm.

emboss.foilBump.description: Share of the scene's bump map on the foil and on the hologram sticker's cover film (the hot die's polish flattens surface texture; 1 = the full map).

emboss.holo.type.description: Reflection (Denisyuk volume hologram: full parallax, Bragg colour) or rainbow (embossed Benton: horizontal parallax, vertical colour sweep).

emboss.holo.size.description: Size of the recorded object (its longest dimension) in % of the sticker's shorter side: the image scales with the sticker. Unit: %.

emboss.holo.depth.description: Depth of the object centre in % of the sticker's shorter side (negative = behind the film; parts may come forward). Unit: %.

emboss.holo.yaw.description: Recorded pose: turn about the vertical axis. Unit: °.

emboss.holo.pitch.description: Recorded pose: tip about the horizontal axis (positive: top toward the viewer). Unit: °.

emboss.holo.recLight.description: Direction of the recording light (baked shading), direction cosines in the sticker frame.

emboss.holo.speckle.description: Contrast of the recorded laser speckle.

emboss.holo.backdrop.description: Background layer: a deep plane recorded behind the object (grid, stars) or a diffractive surface-relief pattern around it (seal … sparkle: each line family is a grating with its own direction, so it flashes its own rainbow colour as the card tilts).

emboss.holo.backdropDepth.description: Depth of the recorded background layer (grid, stars) in % of the sticker's shorter side. Unit: %.

emboss.holo.patternSize.description: Diffractive pattern: radius of the seal / scale of the pattern in % of the sticker's shorter side (50 = the seal spans the patch), centred on the sticker. Unit: %.

emboss.holo.lineWidth.description: Diffractive pattern: line width as a fraction of the line spacing (lines finer than ≈ 2 px fade to their mean coverage).

emboss.holo.gratingPitch.description: Diffractive pattern: period of the relief grating inside the lines (λ = Λ·|(ℓ̂ + v̂)ₜ·ĝ| in the first order: finer → the colours need steeper light). Unit: nm.

emboss.holo.patternStrength.description: Diffractive pattern: brightness (grating coverage × efficiency gain; 1 = metallised lines at full first-order efficiency).

emboss.holo.patternRotation.description: Diffractive pattern: rotation about the hologram centre. Unit: °.

emboss.holo.patternDepth.description: Diffractive pattern: depth of its plane behind the film in % of the sticker's shorter side (0 = on the film; shallow, as on real 2D/3D labels). Unit: %.

emboss.holo.colour.description: Replay wavelength at the reference geometry (reflection: Bragg colour, shrinkage included; rainbow: the straight-on colour). Unit: nm.

emboss.holo.bandwidth.description: Reflection: Bragg bandwidth (FWHM; thicker emulsion → narrower). Unit: nm.

emboss.holo.reference.description: Reference (replay) beam direction cosines in the sticker frame: where the light must be for the undistorted image.

emboss.holo.selectivity.description: Reflection: half-width σ of the replay window on the replayed direction (the image fades as the light leaves the reference or the eye the viewing zone). Unit: °.

emboss.holo.slit.description: Rainbow: vertical slit width (colour purity vs vertical viewing zone). Unit: °.

emboss.holo.recording.description: Optical recording of the object (continuous parallax) or a holographic stereogram made from N camera views (the 3D image steps from view to view as you move, with a brief double image at the boundaries; diffractive patterns stay continuous).

emboss.holo.views.description: Stereogram: number of recorded views across the viewing zone (per axis; rainbow: horizontal only).

emboss.holo.viewBlend.description: Stereogram: width of the cross-fade at a view boundary as a fraction of the view spacing (0 = hard cuts; higher = a longer ghosted double image).

emboss.holo.viewZone.description: Stereogram: half-angle of the zone the views span (beyond it the edge view stays). Unit: °.

emboss.holo.coatAlpha.description: Roughness of the sticker's glossy cover film. Unit: GGX α.

emboss.holo.glare.description: How strongly the surface mirrors the lights: 1 = the physical mirror (rainbow: bare aluminium; both: the cover film's full highlight), lower = the embossed film's zero order is weaker and hazier, the cover film's glint smaller, and the highlight is soft-limited so the image and the pattern stay visible under it.

emboss.filmUm.description: Thickness of the sticker's laminate (photopolymer + cover film on a black backing): the step at its die-cut edge, which catches a thin specular line and casts a hairline shadow on the paper. Unit: µm.

emboss.filmWall.description: How far the sticker's film runs down the emboss walls: 0 = the patch lies on the raised plateau and the die's shoulder (paper) frames it, as when a sticker is laminated onto a blind-embossed pad; 1 = the film runs to the foot of the wall (the die is the sticker's shape).

emboss.print.description: Image card: the picture printed on the paper (an uploaded image, scaled to ≤ 1600 px); the card takes its proportions (long side 88 mm) and stickers sit on top; empty = the plain paper card.

emboss.printInk.description: Image card: how strongly the ink covers the paper (1 = the picture as it is; lower = a faded print, the paper's colour showing through).

emboss.paperColour.description: Paper colour (as-measured diffuse reflectance). A colour as #rrggbb.

emboss.stock.description: Paper stock: selecting one writes its preset of the paper dials; also selects the stock's surface pattern.

emboss.textureStrength.description: Overall strength of the paper micro-structure (relief and albedo).

emboss.fibreAmount.description: Surface fibres per area (paper maps rebuilt).

emboss.fibreScale.description: Fibre length (×, 1 = 0.5–3 mm) and width (×√, 1 = 15–40 µm) (paper maps rebuilt).

emboss.tooth.description: RMS height of the paper surface (tooth, fibres, felt marks). Unit: µm.

emboss.formation.description: Cloudy fibre-density mottling (1–6 mm) in albedo and translucency.

emboss.roughness.description: Micro-roughness below the texture: Oren–Nayar σ and the sheen lobe width.

emboss.sheen.description: Strength of the broad specular sheen of the uncoated surface (F0 0.04).

emboss.translucency.description: Light diffusing inside the cotton stock: wrapped diffuse, softened micro-shadows.

emboss.thickness.description: Card thickness (heavy stock); the card edge shows the paper. Unit: mm.

emboss.waviness.description: RMS slope of the paper's cockle (8–40 mm waviness of the sheet). Unit: °.

emboss.paperBump.description: The scene's bump map also on the paper (it always applies to the foil).

emboss.exposure.description: Exposure compensation of this material on top of the display exposure (which is set for specular foil cards): a photographer exposes a white paper card for the paper. Unit: stops.

emboss.seed.description: Paper micro-structure, foil breakup and sparkle cells.

emboss.doc.description: The paper card's elements as compact JSON (several logos and hologram stickers, each with its own settings); empty = the single element of the values above.
